subject: ParcelIQ pilot - request to sustain sandbox access while webhook fix is applied
messages:
From: Olivia Bennett <olivia@parceliq.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.s@parceliq.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pause: webhook auth failing — asking for sandbox continuity and test credits

Hi Diego,

We're in the middle of wiring ParcelIQ's webhook consumer into Redwood's staging environment and hit an auth mismatch on the inbound signature. Our engineers traced it to a header canonicalization difference between our pipeline and the staging load balancer — it looks like we need a small code change and a redeploy.

This means our scheduled demo window (next Tue) is at risk and our QA team needs additional time to re-run the full integration tests. Two asks:
- Can you extend our pilot sandbox access by ~3 weeks while we finish the fix?
- Can Redwood provision a small set of test credits (enough for ~15k tokens/tests) so we can retest without exhausting our current sandbox allocation?

I attached the error log for context. We can share more telemetry if helpful. We'd rather avoid restarting procurement but need runway to get the integration across the line.

Appreciate any help — happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Thanks,
Olivia Bennett
Head of Integrations
ParcelIQ
[Attachment: webhook-error.log (text, 72KB)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia@parceliq.com>
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.s@parceliq.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause: webhook auth failing — asking for sandbox continuity and test credits

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and for sending the log.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can extend the sandbox access while you complete the fix, and we can discuss a temporary test credit grant. I want to bring Marissa (CS) and our ops lead into the thread to scope the ask and confirm the authorization path.

Can you confirm:
- Which sandbox org ID are you using (so we can scope credits to that environment)?
- Expected ETA for the fix (ballpark is fine: days vs weeks)?
- Any scheduled demo / go-live dates we should be aware of so we can prioritize?

I'll tentatively propose a 14-day extension and an initial 10k token pool pending internal approval; Marissa, can you pick this up and advise on safety controls (billing/limits) if we do a one-off credit?

If it's helpful we can do a quick sync tomorrow.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot pause: webhook auth failing — asking for sandbox continuity and test credits

Diego — read the log and did a short run-through with engineering. Summary:
- Root cause: header canonicalization mismatch between ParcelIQ signing code and our staging LB (not an auth key leak).
- Fix complexity: low (single patch and redeploy), but QA cycle and regen of signed payloads will take ~5–7 business days to validate in staging and run regression tests.
- Risk: low to our production tenant footprint if we scope credits to the sandbox org and keep rate limits in place.

Recommendation: Approve a 21-day sandbox extension + 15,000 token test credit for the ParcelIQ sandbox org (org-id: parceliq-stg-03). Restrict credits to the sandbox org and add a soft cap alert to CS if usage spikes. I attached a short one-pager with the integration notes.

Attachment: integration-analysis.pdf (3 pages)

Dev — can you confirm whether we need a formal deal amendment or if this is an approved one-off pilot top-up?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot pause: webhook auth failing — asking for sandbox continuity and test credits

Marissa — thanks for the assessment and the suggested guardrails. Approve the recommendation: grant ParcelIQ a 21-day extension + 15,000 token sandbox credit scoped to parceliq-stg-03. No change to pricing or contract terms required for this one-off.

Operational asks:
- Diego: please add the extension and the credit to the HubSpot record and mark the deal DL-2027-0897 as "pilot-extended".
- Marissa: please set a soft alert when usage exceeds 12k tokens so we can catch unexpected spikes.

I logged the approval here: https://hubspot.example/deal/DL-2027-0897. For audit trail, I also started a DocuSign packet (link below) to capture the pilot amendment acknowledgement (simple e-sign). Not strictly required but useful for enterprise buyers.

DocuSign (optional): https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/packet/abc123

— Dev Patel
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia@parceliq.com>
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.s@parceliq.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause: webhook auth failing — asking for sandbox continuity and test credits

Hi Olivia — good news. Per internal approval we've granted ParcelIQ a 21-day extension to your pilot sandbox and a 15,000 token test credit scoped to org ID parceliq-stg-03.

What we did:
- Extended sandbox access: until 2027-04-09 (21 days from today).
- Credited 15,000 test tokens to parceliq-stg-03; usage limited to the sandbox environment.
- Set a soft alert at 12k tokens and a hard cap at 16k tokens — we'll notify you if the soft alert trips.

Next steps on our side:
- I'll update HubSpot (DL-2027-0897) with the extension and the credit.
- Marissa will monitor usage and coordinate with you for a follow-up demo when you confirm the fix.
- If you'd like the optional DocuSign acknowledgement, sign here: https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/packet/abc123

If you want to schedule a short troubleshooting call, Marissa and I are available Mon/Tue next week — say the word and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
